scripts.lint: bash -c 'export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH; uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .'
scripts.format: bash -c 'export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH; uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .'
scripts.typecheck: bash -c 'export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH; uv run mypy cognee_community_connector_gitgraph tests examples scripts'
scripts.e2e:install: bash -c 'export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH; uv run playwright install chromium'
scripts.demo:video:fast: bash -c 'export DEMO_VIDEO_SKIP_GATE=1 PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH; uv run python scripts/demo_video.py'
scripts.docker:demo: docker run --rm --network none cognee-gitgraph bun run demo
